name: Staged Review
description: A pre-commit review panel for what you have staged: a summary, a whitespace check, and a TODO/FIXME scan over the staged files — plus a voice-and-copy Tama skin for the reviewer.

commands.label: Staged Review: Check staged changes for whitespace problems
commands.run: git diff --cached --check && echo ::gitcat.tama ok No whitespace problems in the staged changes.

commands.label: Staged Review: Find TODO/FIXME in staged files
commands.run: grep -nE 'TODO|FIXME' -- {files} || echo ::gitcat.tama ok No TODO or FIXME in the staged files.

items.text: Each check below looks only at what is staged right now. Press Re-run on an output to run that check; nothing runs until you do.

items.label: Find TODO / FIXME in staged files

copy.applied: Staged Review on duty. I'll look over what you're about to commit.
